name: Employee U
what_you_do: Take part in a flexible 8 week program. Go to lunch and learn sessions on work skills. Do volunteer work. You get a certificate and a letter of recommendation.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. Cost is not listed either.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Use the Register link on the program page. The page does not list the steps.
notes: You also get help with your resume and may be placed in a job at the Y. The page does not list locations, so ask your nearest Y.
